130K likes, 460 comments - bazaarindia on September 12, 2026: "Motherhood has given Kiara Advani (@kiaraaliaadvani) a new perspective on the women around her, but perhaps more importantly, it has changed the way she sees herself. There is no neat arrival point, she says, only the ongoing discovery of who you become when your priorities, time, and emotions begin to shift. 

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.
